description: Kestra workflow orchestration on the automation host: micrometer metrics scraped by Alloy from kestra:8081/prometheus, plus its container logs in Loki.

panels.title: Kestra scrape
panels.description: up{job=kestra} — Alloy scraping kestra:8081/prometheus on the automation host.

panels.title: JVM uptime
panels.description: Time since the Kestra JVM started — a reset means the container restarted.

panels.title: Executions failed
panels.description: Executions ending in FAILED or KILLED over the range.

panels.title: Average execution duration
panels.description: Kestra timers export _count/_sum/_max only — there are no histogram buckets, so this is a true average, not a quantile.

panels.title: Executions by flow
panels.description: Executions that ended in the selected range, per flow and final state.

panels.title: Task runs by type
panels.description: Worker-side task completions grouped by the task plugin type.

panels.title: Worker jobs
panels.description: Pending climbing while threads stay flat = the worker pool is saturated.

panels.title: Average worker queue wait
panels.description: How long a task waits before a worker thread picks it up.

panels.title: Scheduler activity
panels.description: Evaluation loops flatlining at zero means the scheduler has stopped ticking and no cron trigger will fire. Not kestra_scheduler_loop_count_total — that one counts scheduler *starts* over the process lifetime, so its rate is always 0.

panels.title: Queue poll size
panels.description: Rows returned per poll of each JDBC (Postgres) queue — sustained growth means a consumer is falling behind.

panels.title: Postgres connection pool (HikariCP)
panels.description: Kestra's JDBC backend is the central Postgres server over mTLS. Pending > 0 means flows are blocked waiting for a connection.

panels.title: JDBC query duration
panels.description: Every queue poll and repository read is a Postgres round trip over mTLS, so this is the sharpest signal that the shared database is the bottleneck. Deliberately not grouped by the sql label — it holds full statement text.

panels.title: Log volume by level
panels.description: The level label is set by Alloy's kestra stage.match pipeline.

panels.title: Kestra logs
panels.description: Stack traces arrive as a single entry — Alloy joins logback continuation lines before shipping.

title: Homelab — Kestra
